description: The term registry: every ontology term an NDI V2 import writes in a vocabulary slot (a variable, method, unit, condition, parameter or key), so the next dataset reuses it. AUTHORED: tools/build_v_eta.py copies it into schemas/V_eta/stable/term_registry_meta.json, which did2.build checks against (strictMode 'TermRegistry'). Tenet T19; V_eta_term_registry_plan.md. status 'decided': a term with its node; 'staged': registered by name, its node still to be found or minted. A new entry follows T19's order: a term already here, else an existing ontology's, else a new EMPTY term.

terms.name: acceleration
terms.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of change of the bearer's velocity in either speed or direction.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: acclimation plate
terms.definition: A Petri dish of seeded agar on which animals are kept for a set time before an assay so that they adapt to its conditions.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: after the encounter
terms.definition: The period from the end of an encounter to the start of the subject's next one, or to the end of its record.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: agar
terms.definition: A complex mixture of polysaccharides extracted from species of red algae. Its two main components are agarose and agaropectin. Agarose is the component responsible for the high-strength gelling properties of agar, while agaropectin provides the viscous properties.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: analysis window end
terms.definition: The end of the stretch of a time series a value was computed from, as a signed time from a reference time point (NCIT:C82576) given with it: negative before the reference, positive after.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: analysis window start
terms.definition: The start of the stretch of a time series a value was computed from, as a signed time from a reference time point (NCIT:C82576) given with it: negative before the reference, positive after.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: arbitrary unit per millisecond
terms.definition: A unit of rate equal to one arbitrary unit (an instrument-relative quantity, such as fluorescence intensity in camera counts) per millisecond, used for a signal in arbitrary units normalized by exposure time.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: arena
terms.definition: The bounded region in which an experiment's subjects are confined and observed.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: arena diameter
terms.definition: The diameter of the arena: the bounded region in which an experiment's subjects are confined and observed.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Arithmetic Mean
terms.definition: The sum of a set of values divided by the number of values in the set.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: assay plate
terms.definition: A Petri dish of agar, prepared with the arena and bacterial patches of an assay, on which animals are recorded during that assay.

terms.name: bacteria growth duration after seeding
terms.definition: The time from when a bacterial patch was seeded on an agar plate to the start of the assay, during which the bacteria grew.

terms.name: target seeding OD600
terms.definition: The OD600 a bacterial suspension was prepared to have when it was seeded: the planned value, as distinct from a measured one.

terms.name: Sample Type

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Petri Dish
terms.definition: A shallow dish with a lid used to culture cells.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: bacterial patch
terms.definition: A discrete area of bacteria grown on a solid medium from a pipetted suspension.

terms.name: bacterial patch volume

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Baseline
terms.definition: A starting point to which things may be compared.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: before the first encounter
terms.definition: The period from the start of a subject's record to the start of its first encounter.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: behavioral state
terms.definition: A state of an animal's behavior, such as exploiting a food source or sensing it, of which a classifier may give the probability.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: bin width
terms.definition: A setting of a data transformation that groups values by a variable: the width of each group along that variable.

terms.name: Binary Mask
terms.definition: A mapping of pixels used to define a region of interest in an image. Each pixel is designated as either belonging to the region of interest or part of the background by using ones or zeros, respectively.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: body midpoint
terms.definition: The point halfway along an animal's body midline.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Body Part
terms.definition: Any part of an organism.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: brightfield imaging
terms.definition: An imaging assay in which a specimen is lit from behind and recorded against a bright background, with a camera and lens rather than a microscope, as in the video recording of animals on a backlit plate.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: oblique illumination imaging
terms.definition: Imaging a specimen lit from one side at a low angle, so that its edges and surface relief show as differences in brightness.

terms.name: calcium chloride dihydrate
terms.definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of calcium chloride.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: calcium chloride solution
terms.definition: An aqueous solution of calcium chloride, kept as a stock for adding calcium to culture media. Its concentration is a property of each preparation, not of this class.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.definition: A penicillin antibiotic having a 6β-2-carboxy-2-phenylacetamido side-chain.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: cholesterol
terms.definition: A cholestanoid consisting of cholestane having a double bond at the 5,6-position as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: cholesterol solution
terms.definition: A solution of cholesterol in ethanol, kept as a stock for adding cholesterol to nematode culture media. Its concentration is a property of each preparation, not of this class.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: circularity
terms.definition: How close a two-dimensional shape is to a circle: 4 pi times its area divided by the square of its perimeter, 1 for a circle and smaller for any other shape.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Citric acid monohydrate
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Classification
terms.definition: A method of generalization, the systematic arrangement of entities into classes or groups based on mutual similarity and certain differing characteristics.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: coefficient of determination
terms.definition:
The coefficient of determination is a data item measuring the proportion of the variance in the dependent variable that is predictable from the independent variable(s).
In the case of a linear regression mode, the coefficient of determination r2 is the quotient of the variances of the fitted values and observed values of the dependent variable.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Coordinate
terms.definition: A number or other designation that identifies a position relative to an axis or grid.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate
terms.definition: The pentahydrate of copper(2+) sulfate. A bright blue crystalline solid.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: culture medium
terms.definition: a processed material that provides the needed nourishment for microorganisms or cells grown in vitro.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Developmental Stage
terms.definition: A general term that usually refers to named landmark events during development of an organism.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: diameter
terms.definition: A length quality which is equal to the length of any straight line segment that passes through the center of a circle and whose endpoints are on the circular boundary.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: dipotassium hydrogen phosphate
terms.definition: A potassium salt that is the dipotassium salt of phosphoric acid.

terms.name: dipotassium hydrogen phosphate trihydrate
terms.definition: The trihydrate of dipotassium hydrogen phosphate, K2HPO4.3H2O (molar mass 228.22 g/mol), the form weighed out for some buffers: a given mass of it holds less phosphate than the same mass of the anhydrous salt.

terms.name: distance

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: distance end point
terms.definition: The point to which a distance is measured, paired with the reference point (NCIT:C45793) it is measured from.

terms.name: distance transform
terms.definition: A data transformation that gives, for each point of an image, its distance to the nearest edge of a region in a binary mask, signed by whether the point is inside or outside the region.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: during the encounter
terms.definition: The period from the start to the end of an encounter, including any frames in which the subject is partly out of contact.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: EDTA disodium salt dihydrate
terms.definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of EDTA disodium salt.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Encounter
terms.definition: Each individual, unique interaction between two subjects of interest.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: encounter detection
terms.definition: A data transformation that finds the periods in which a subject is in contact with another entity, from its position relative to that entity over time.

terms.definition: The time at which a subject's encounter begins.

terms.name: encounter period
terms.definition: The period of a subject's record a value is computed over, relative to its encounters: before its first encounter, during an encounter, or after an encounter.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: encounter type
terms.definition: The kind of patch encounter an animal made, assigned from the probabilities of its behavioral states.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: encountered entity

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: entity in contact
terms.definition: The entity a subject is in contact with during each of its encounters.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Environmental Temperature
terms.definition: The temperature of the surroundings.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: ethanol

terms.name: exploit

terms.name: exploitation
terms.definition: The behavioral state of staying on and feeding from a food source, as against exploring away from it.

terms.name: fasting

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Fluorescence Intensity

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Fluorescence Microscopy
terms.definition: A technique in which samples that either contain fluorescent compounds or are stained with fluorescent dyes are exposed to a wavelength of light that excites the fluorophore, allowing for an image to be captured by a microscope.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Brightfield Microscopy
terms.definition: Brightfield microscopy is a type of light microscopy in which objects are seen against a bright background.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: food availability

terms.name: food deprivation plate

terms.name: Proportion

terms.decided: Jess Haley, 2026-10-20 (Haley term audit X-3: NCIT Fraction means a fragment)

terms.name: head
terms.definition: The head is the anterior-most division of the body [GO].
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: hour
terms.definition: The hour is a unit of time defined as 3600 second.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: image down
terms.definition: The direction along an image's columns from its top edge toward its bottom edge, in which the row number increases.

terms.name: Image Registration

terms.name: image right
terms.definition: The direction along an image's rows from its left edge toward its right edge, in which the column number increases.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: image segmentation
terms.definition: An image transformation that partitions an image into distinct objects, groups, or regions. Typically represented by spatial coordinates or an image mask of integer values at each pixel or voxel position.

terms.definition: The upper-left corner of an image as it is stored and displayed: the origin of pixel coordinates that count columns to the right and rows downward.

terms.name: Imaging Region of Interest
terms.definition: A specific area of interest defined by a sequence of image overlays or a sequence of contours described as a single point (for a point ROI) or more than one point (representing and open or closed polygon).
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: Imaging Signal Intensity

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: inclusion in analysis
terms.definition: Whether a subject, or the data recorded from it, was included in a study's analysis. A yes/no property: stated as false where a subject was excluded, and not stated for the subjects that were included.

terms.name: intercept
terms.definition: an intercept is a data item which corresponds to where a graph line cuts (intercepts) an coordinates axis.

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: iron(2+) sulfate heptahydrate
terms.definition: A hydrate that is the heptahydrate form of iron(2+) sulfate. It is used as a source of iron in the treatment of iron-deficiency anaemia (generally in liquid-dosage treatments; for solid-dosage treatments, the monohydrate is normally used).
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: L4 larva Ce
terms.definition: The fourth stage larva. At 25 Centigrade, it ranges 40-49.5 hours after fertilization, 26-35.5 hours after hatch.
terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.first_used_in: Haley et al. 2025, C. elegans foraging (NDI-matlab ndi.setup.conv.haley)

terms.name: linear regression for analysis of continuous dependent variable

linear regression model is a model which attempts to explain data distribution associated with response/dependent variable in terms of values assumed by the independent variable uses a linear function or linear combination of the regression parameters and the predictor/independent variable(s).
linear regression modeling makes a number of assumptions, which includes homoskedasticity (constance of variance)

terms.name: regression coefficient
terms.definition:
a regression coefficient is a measure of association that is used as the coefficient of an independent variable in a regression model, of the dependent variable, which is linear in its parameters.

A value of zero means no association. The sign (positive or negative) reflects the direction of association.

a regression coefficient is a measure of association  generated by a type of data transformation called a regression, which aims to model a response variable by expression the predictor variables as part of a function where variable terms are modified by a number. A regression coefficient is one such number.

terms.name: study design independent variable
terms.definition: a directive information entity that is part of a study design. Independent variables are entities whose values are selected to determine its relationship to an observed phenomenon (the dependent variable). In such an experiment, an attempt is made to find evidence that the values of the independent variable determine the values of the dependent variable (that which is being measured). The independent variable can be changed as required, and its values do not represent a problem requiring explanation in an analysis, but are taken simply as given.
